messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Oscilloscope in Aerospace / Defense, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

### 推薦先賣
| Opportunity | Evidence-supported reason |
|---|---|
| UAV image-processing / camera electronics using GMSL / LVDS is the most directly evidenced oscilloscope opportunity, because the UAV eco-chain maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO, and the high-speed digital source separately lists GMSL and LVDS among high-speed interfaces while connecting interface testing to scopes [35][41][51][52]. |
| UAV battery / power and motor / gimbal electronics are direct MXO leads, because UAVEcoChain lists 德鑫新技 in 電池電源 and 其昜先進 in 馬達動力雲台, and the R&S solution mapping lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 as R&S MXO leads [35][41]. |
| High-speed digital SI/PI and PCB/PCBA validation is a broader oscilloscope opportunity, because the R&S digital-test source connects Interface Test and PDN validation to scopes, and the PCB/PCBA flow includes TDR impedance, IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, DK/DF, roughness and process-monitoring contexts, but the source does not tie this directly to a specific A&D account or scope model [51][71][72]. |
| Military / aviation drone EMC and EME is a strong A&D test domain but not yet an oscilloscope-proven opportunity in the vault, because the sources support MIL-STD-461 / MIL-STD-464 / RTCA DO-160 and complex EME emulation needs, but the cited pages do not map RTO, MXO, or scopes to those EMC/EME tests [4][61][62][63]. |
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO | UAV image-processing / camera electronics where 邑錡 is listed with GMSL and LVDS [35][41]. | 知識庫未標示 RTO option code, bandwidth, probe, software, fixture, or test method for this UAV mapping [41]. | The evidence directly maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO in the UAV solution mapping [41]. | UAVEcoChain lists 邑錡 under 影像處理-相機 with GMSL and LVDS, and the R&S solution mapping lists 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS → R&S RTO, R&S MXO [35][41]. | The mapping cannot be rewritten as a formal configuration guide, sold opportunity, customer adoption, certification, or test result [41]. |
| R&S MXO | UAV image-processing / camera, battery / power, and motor / gimbal nodes where 邑錡, 德鑫新技, and 其昜先進 are mapped to MXO-related leads [35][41]. | 知識庫未標示 MXO option code, bandwidth, probe, software, fixture, or measurement procedure for these UAV mappings [41]. | The evidence directly maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S MXO and also lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 as MXO leads [35][41]. | UAVEcoChain lists 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS → R&S RTO and R&S MXO, and lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 → R&S MXO [35][41]. | The workbook contains many company / role leads but mostly lacks product model, formal specification, customer, supply relationship, shipment, certification, bid, revenue, or market-share evidence [34]. |
| Oscilloscope instrument class | High-speed digital interface test and PDN validation [51]. | 知識庫未標示 oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, jitter mask, PDN impedance target, or formal test standard for this source [51]. | The source explicitly connects Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices, and connects Power Distribution Network validation to scopes and network analyzers [51]. | The SerDes / SI-PI testing overview lists scopes under Interface Test and PDN validation, and separately lists SI flow items such as IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram and TDR Impedance [49][51]. | This source is a high-speed digital test source and does not by itself prove an Aerospace / Defense customer fit or a specific RTO / MXO configuration [51][60]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| UAV camera / image-processing boards | R&S RTO or R&S MXO where the account context matches 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS [35][41]. | Use the directly evidenced UAV mapping first, then support the discussion with the generic high-speed interface-test evidence that scopes are used for Interface Test [41][51]. | The vault does not provide GMSL / LVDS version, data rate, compliance test item, RTO / MXO option, probe, fixture, or pass/fail condition [41][52]. |
| UAV battery / power and motor / gimbal electronics | R&S MXO where the account context matches 德鑫新技 or 其昜先進 [35][41]. | Use the UAVEcoChain mapping because it directly lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 as MXO leads [35][41]. | The vault does not state the electrical measurement item, voltage/current range, power-analysis option, motor-control method, or customer adoption result [34][41]. |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA and SI/PI validation for system houses | Oscilloscope instrument class, with product model to be confirmed outside the current evidence [51][71][72]. | Use the R&S PCB test-solutions flow around TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, sampling testing and process monitoring [71]. | The source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [72]. |
| Military / aviation drone EMC and EME discussions | Do not lead with oscilloscope as a proven solution unless additional evidence is added [4][61][62][63]. | The supported A&D need is EMC / EME standards and complex electromagnetic-environment emulation, including MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464 and RTCA DO-160 contexts [4][61][62]. | The vault does not map RTO, MXO, or oscilloscope measurements to MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, HPM, EMP, lightning, RADHAZ, or EME emulation setups [63]. |
### 限制
The vault does not provide an evidence-based ranking of oscilloscope opportunities in Aerospace / Defense, so no “strongest” ranking is proven [41][51].  
The R&S solution-mapping rows cannot be treated as formal configurations, sold opportunities, customer adoption, certification, or test results [41].  
The high-speed digital and PCB sources do not provide scope model, bandwidth, data rate, option code, fixture, calibration method, or pass/fail criteria [51][72].  
The military / aviation drone EMC and EME sources support the A&D test domain, but they do not provide an oscilloscope product mapping or executable test parameters [63].

- TS 38.108 定義 SAN radio transmission and reception。
- TS 38.181 定義 SAN conformance testing tolerances 與 test cases。
- SAN type 包含 type 1-H、type 1-O、type 2-O。
- FR1 hybrid setup 可 conducted 或 radiated；FR2 only OTA / radiated。
- TS 38.181 chapters 包含 conducted transmitter、conducted receiver、conducted performance、radiated transmitter、radiated receiver、radiated performance。
- 測試重點包含 output power、power dynamics、frequency error、modulation quality、ACLR、OBUE、receiver sensitivity、blocking、PUSCH / PUCCH / PRACH performance。

NTN test and measurement aspects › NTN 對 T&M 的 paradigm change
來源指出 [[NTN]] 改變傳統 wireless T&M 假設：

- 傳統假設 UE mobile、network entities stationary。
- NTN 需考慮 UE 與 network entities 兩者 mobility。
- 測試條件需 reproducible、accurate、comparable，但 setup 需加入 high path loss、Doppler shift、time delay、delay variance、atmospheric effects、Faraday effect、scintillation、weather influences。
- satellite 入軌後 maintenance / replacement 困難，使 simulation、software-assisted testing、digital twin、in-orbit monitoring 更重要。

NTN test and measurement aspects › R&S CMX500 與 TS8980
來源將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 5G NTN 測試平台：

- 可作 one-box testing setup。
- 可整合進 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- 支援 NR-NTN、NB-NTN、DTC。
- 可執行 RF、protocol、signaling、E2E application、mobility、application testing。
- 支援 FR1、FR2 與 future FR3 regions 的 white paper level 描述；正式 frequency coverage 需回查產品 specs / heads / RF frontends。
- 支援 Constellation Insight tool，可 load、configure、visualize、deploy satellites。
- CMX500 hardware 同時可啟動 cells 數量有限；來源說目前一台 box 最多 six cells。

[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]：

- 補充並擴展 CMX500。
- 支援 full type approval functionality。
- 支援 multiple cells、out-of-band emission、spurious emission、interfering / blocking performance tests。
- 作為 accredited / validated test platform 用於 conformance / certification。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

SDR-assisted UAV security
[[SDR-assisted UAV security]] 是使用 [[Software-Defined Radio]] 在 UAV 系統中執行 PHY-layer monitoring、jamming detection、GPS spoofing / jamming assessment、intrusion detection、penetration testing 與 counter-UAV research 的安全技術方向；它同時包含防禦能力與攻擊面風險。

- 本來源是一份 OneNote / Microsoft 365 chat 複製出的「台灣無人機產業分析報告（2025年版）」架構與內容摘要，主題是 [[台灣無人機產業]]、[[台灣無人機供應鏈]]、政策、技術與市場機會。
- 來源稱台灣無人機產業在 2025 年上半年外銷金額達 1,189 萬美元，年增超過 7 倍；但該數字來自來源內引用的 [[數位時代 BusinessNext]] 連結，raw 未擷取連結正文。
- 來源稱政府投入 500 億元推動軍用無人機採購，並成立 [[台灣卓越無人機海外商機聯盟]]，但未提供政府公告、預算科目或聯盟正式文件。
- 來源稱全球無人機市場預估由 2024 年 730 億美元成長至 2030 年 1,636 億美元，CAGR 約 14.3%；該數字來自來源內引用的 PDF 連結，raw 未擷取 PDF 正文。
- 來源稱台灣國防部預計於 2026–2027 年間採購 5 萬架無人機；raw 未擷取該主張的正式採購公告或標案文件。
- 來源把無人機供應鏈分成上游晶片 / 感測器 / 通訊模組、中游模組製造與系統整合、下游整機製造與應用服務三層，列出 [[聯發科]]、[[新唐科技]]、[[圓剛]]、[[聰泰]]、[[亞光]]、[[中光電]]、[[漢翔]]、[[雷虎科技]]、[[經緯航太]]與[[長榮航太]]等公司。

- 通訊設備製造商：核心網、5G 基站、光傳輸設備、交換機、路由器等。
- 服務器與資料中心：協助 AI、高效能計算環境部署，需求高速內部連與介面連接。
- 網通基礎建設與雲端應用：包含物聯網、雲計算與邊緣運算等場域皆需高速數據傳輸與處理能力。

- 工業與智慧製造：工業自動化系統、高速資料擷取與辨識也仰賴高速訊號鏈路。

5G private network resilience against smart jamming › Mission context 與 industry drivers
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

passages.text:
5G private network resilience against smart jamming › 測試 outcome
[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 的 outcome 投影片聲稱：

- both modems showed sufficient performance for running video call；
- throughput performance 與 [[WebRTC]] statistics 被用來評估；
- video-call reliability 在 smart-jammer pressure 下透過 FH-aligned approach 維持；
- 來源口語說明稱 jitter / packet loss contained。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 提供更完整數字：

- modem B 的 HO interruption interval never employs more than 75 ms；modem A 可到 150 ms。
- RTT 大多數時間（> 90%）低於 20 ms；0.1 percentile modem B 接近 80 ms、modem A 接近 200 ms。
- late target cell activation 0–3 s waiting time 的 mean HO interruption interval 均為 68.0 ms，90% 均為 69 ms。
- HO period 5 s 到 1 s 的 mean HO interruption interval 約 67.9–68.0 ms，90% 與 99% 均為 69 ms。
- 一小時 [[Microsoft Teams]] / [[WebRTC]] video call：average RTT 127.8 ms、jitter buffer delay 53.1 ms、lost or discarded packets 0.0095%、reliability > 99.99%。
- 白皮書結論稱最差 scenario（每秒跳頻、且下一個 cell 先前未啟用）下，data interruptions contained below 75 ms in 99% of the time。

UAV 通訊 › 硬體元件
[[Communication of UAVs]] 列出下列 communication module hardware components：

- Radio transceivers：處理 RF communication for control and telemetry。
- Antennas：確保 signal reliability 並延伸 communication range。
- Satcom modules：支援 satellite communication for BVLOS operations。
- 4G/5G modems：提供 cellular connectivity for data-intensive applications。
- IoT gateways：將 UAV 整合到 IoT ecosystems。
- FPV modules：提供 live video transmission to operators。

來源未提供供應商、模組型號、頻段、功率、天線增益、環境條件、認證或 R&S 測試配置。

UAV 通訊 › 技術挑戰
來源列出 UAV 通訊挑戰：

- Range：長距離可靠通信。
- Interference：多 RF devices 環境下管理 signal overlap。
- Latency：real-time control 與 video streaming 的低延遲。
- Bandwidth：處理 video 與 LiDAR feeds 等大量資料。
- Security：防護 jamming、spoofing、unauthorized access。
- Power efficiency：降低能源消耗以保留 UAV battery life。

[[Signaling test solution]] 的 De-sense validation 線索與 Interference 挑戰相連，但該來源未提供具體 test methodology。

UAV 通訊 › 應用場景
[[Communication of UAVs]] 列出：

- Surveillance and inspection：透過 RF 或 cellular networks 傳送 high-resolution video streams。
- Search and rescue：UAV 與 GPS devices 或 IoT beacons 通訊以定位人員。
- Agriculture：UAV-mounted sensors 的 data 分享給 ground stations 分析。
- Delivery services：整合 cloud-based systems 做 route planning 與 tracking。
- Military：使用 encrypted communication 做 secure C2 與 payload data transmission。

這些是應用分類，不是特定產品、客戶、法規或供應鏈證據。

UAV 通訊 › 通訊鏈路類型
[[Communication of UAVs]] 將 UAV 通訊鏈路分成：

- UAV-to-GCS：UAV 與 [[Ground Control Station]] 之間交換 command、telemetry 與 data。
- UAV-to-UAV：UAV 之間為 swarm 或 collaborative operations 進行 coordination，可使用 [[Mesh Networks]] 或 custom protocols。
- UAV-to-Cloud：real-time data upload 到 cloud platforms，用於 analysis、storage 與 AI-based decision-making。
- UAV-to-Human：透過 mobile apps 或 displays 與 operators / field personnel 溝通。

這些是高階鏈路分類；來源沒有提供網路拓樸、routing、handover、security、interoperability 或測試流程。

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
- boost testing for [[Narrowband Non-terrestrial Networks]]（[[NB-NTN]]）[[IoT]] devices connecting via satellite。
- thoroughly validate devices and confirm interoperability with [[Viasat]] network。
- help ensure uninterrupted connectivity for satellite-based [[IoT]] applications。
- ensure chipsets、modules and devices interoperate seamlessly with [[Viasat]] satellite network。
- comply with [[3GPP Release 17]] standards。
- uphold quality、performance and reliability for [[Viasat]] connectivity services in areas without terrestrial network coverage。
- certification test plan entails protocol、performance and RF test scenarios。

5G NTN validation and testing › 來源中的測試目標
依 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]]，[[Gatehouse Satcom]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的合作目標包含：

- strengthen validation and testing of [[5G IoT-NTN]] and [[NR-NTN]] technologies。
- 在市場從 specification work 走向 real-world implementation 時，改善 validation 方法。
- 在 realistic and controlled laboratory conditions 下測試 5G NTN technologies。
- further develop advanced orbit and channel emulation capabilities for NTN use cases。
- 支援更準確的 satellite radio channel modelling。
- 更 realistic testing of 5G NTN behavior across different scenarios。
- 支援 faster validation cycles、earlier identification of system-level issues 與 stronger test conditions。
- reduce technical uncertainty and accelerate time to market for the broader NTN ecosystem。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]，MWC 2024 展示目標包含：

- demonstrate a [[5G Non-Terrestrial Network]] [[New Radio]] connection based on latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。
- emulate a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node。
- showcase 5G technology providing connectivity in areas without terrestrial coverage。
- 展示 basic mobile services，例如 voice、messaging 與 low data rate services，面向 maritime、aeronautical 與 rural applications。
- 在 interactive callbox mode 中讓 users trigger voice calls alongside RF-related measurements。
- 評估 future NTN-NR devices powered by [[MediaTek]] NTN test platform 在不同 conditions 下的 performance and reliability。

依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]，[[Viasat]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NB-NTN IoT test plan 目標包含：

5G NTN validation and testing › 與既有 NTN discovery / configuration 的關係
- [[NTN signaling customer discovery]]：用問卷釐清 service offering、test layer、release、satellite architecture、UE、QoS、mobility 與 constellation deployment；屬於需求蒐集。
- [[R&S NTN signaling solutions]]：目前主要由 customer questionnaire 支撐，代表 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 NTN signaling solution discovery 語境。
- [[CMX500 NR-NTN configuration]]：整理 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 NR-NTN application-specific configuration guide，包含 S/L-band golden callbox、fading、mobility、Ku/Ka-band、preconformance 與 xLAPI automation。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]]：補充 MWC 2024 demo / PR 語境，展示 Rel.17 [[5G NTN-NR]] connection、LEO access node emulation、voice calls 與 RF-related measurements。
- [[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]]：補充 MWC Barcelona 2026 前後的 partner-specific [[NB-NTN]] / [[NB-IoT]] IoT device certification test plan 語境，涵蓋 protocol、performance 與 RF test scenarios。
- 本頁的 PR 來源補充的是 ecosystem collaboration、validation methodology、demo / certification context，不取代需求問卷、configuration guide 或 formal specifications。

5G NTN validation and testing › 軌道與標準化語境
[[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 的標題強調 [[GEO]] and [[LEO]] NTN validation and testing；正文 quote 進一步提到 [[GEO]]、[[MEO]] and [[LEO]] satellite services。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and MediaTek to showcase 5G NTN-NR Rel.17 connection at MWC 2024]] 只明示 emulating a [[Low Earth Orbit]] satellite access node，並將展示連結到 latest [[3GPP Release 17]] specifications。

[[Rohde & Schwarz and Viasat to collaborate on NB-NTN IoT test plan for connectivity via satellite]] 明示 [[3GPP Release 17]] standards 與 [[Viasat]] satellite network interoperability，但未說明 orbit、frequency bands、payload type 或 gateway architecture。

Gatehouse Satcom 來源也將 NTN 產業背景描述為 converges on standardized, [[3GPP]] based solutions，並提到 today’s [[5G NTN]] rollout 與 future [[6G NTN testing and validation]]。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Signal generation、analysis 與 SpaceNexus
來源描述：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可配備 fading emulator，支援 TDL / CDL、custom fading profile、Doppler、delay、path loss，以及 [[R&S SMW-K820]] customized dynamic fading。
- [[R&S SpaceNexus]] 可設定 satellite constellation、UE position / mobility、time-variant Doppler、time-variant propagation delay、path loss、weather-induced attenuation，並 remote configure SMW200A。
- [[R&S FSW]] / [[R&S FSWX]] 支援 satellite payload testing、EVM、ACLR、group delay、DVB-S2X analysis、phase-coherent multichannel measurement。
- [[R&S PVT360A]] 被描述為 potential satellite production testing platform，整合 vector signal generator 與 vector spectrum analyzer。

NTN test and measurement aspects › 使用限制
- 本頁是 T&M 技術總覽；正式 test methods、limits、tolerances、test case IDs 與 validation status 需查 [[TS 38.101-5]]、[[TS 38.521-5]]、[[TS 38.523]]、[[TS 38.533]]、[[TS 38.181]]、[[TS 38.108]]、GCF / PTCRB public documents。
- R&S 產品能力需以正式 datasheet / configuration guide 為準；白皮書中的 solution-level 描述不可直接作為 quote / BOM / orderable capability。
- OTA / PAAM setup 的 fixtures、antenna modules、chamber dimensions、quiet zone、polarization、frequency conversions 等需以原圖與 setup note 回查。

NTN test and measurement aspects › UE NTN testing
UE NTN testing categories：

- RF testing。
- protocol testing。
- performance testing。
- carrier acceptance testing。
- interoperability testing。

相關規格：

- [[TS 38.101-5]]：satellite NR UE RF and performance requirements。
- [[TS 38.521-5]]：NR UE satellite access RF / performance conformance procedures。
- [[TS 38.523]]：protocol conformance。
- [[TS 38.533]]：RRM conformance。
- [[TS 38.133]]：RRM requirements。

目前 RF tests 多聚焦 FR1；來源預期未來會擴展到 FR2、Ka-band、Ku-band 與 moving satellite conditions。

NTN test and measurement aspects › OTA / phased array / PAAM testing
NTN UE、VSAT、SAN、satellite 可能使用 directive antennas / phased array antennas，因此 OTA testing 重要。

來源整理：

- OTA methods：far field、near field、CATR、plane wave conversion、anechoic chamber、reverberation chamber。
- PAAM metrics：radiation pattern、scan loss、pointing error、HPBW、sidelobe levels、EIRP、G/T、noise density、EVM、beam switching。
- NTN beam metrics：beam center、beam peak、beam pair、beam pointing accuracy、beam stability、beam squint、OSDD、beam shape capability。
- Rohde & Schwarz setups 使用 [[R&S ZNA]]、[[R&S SMW200A]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S FSWX]]、[[R&S ATS1800C]]、[[R&S ATS800B]]、[[R&S ATS800R]]、[[R&S ATS1800M]] 等。

NTN test and measurement aspects › Fading profiles and test channels
來源整理 [[TR 38.811]]、[[TR 38.901]] 與 [[TS 38.181]] 的 NTN channel model / test condition：

- [[CDL]]：clustered delay line，適用於 S-band / Ka-band，含 elevation / azimuth 的 3D model。
- [[TDL]]：tapped delay line，用於 multipath power-delay profile。
- TR 38.811 定義 NTN-CDL 與 NTN-TDL profiles，各有 LOS / NLOS profiles。
- TS 38.181 為 SAN testing 定義 NTN-TDLA100、NTN-TDLC5、moving propagation condition。
- Rel. 19 導入 NGSO time-varying Doppler shift and propagation delay channel model，用於更 realistic demodulation / RRM tests。

來源內有一項需保留的讀法限制：同段中 `NTN-TDLA100-200` 被文字描述為 100 ms delay spread，但表格對 NTN-TDLA100 列 100 ns delay spread。此處需回查原 PDF / TS 38.181。

3GPP NTN Signal Generator Solutions Overview-EN-UR › 5G NTN SAN conformance testing

### 推薦先賣
| Opportunity | Evidence-supported reason |
|---|---|
| UAV image-processing / camera electronics using GMSL / LVDS is the most directly evidenced oscilloscope opportunity, because the UAV eco-chain maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO, and the high-speed digital source separately lists GMSL and LVDS among high-speed interfaces while connecting interface testing to scopes [35][41][51][52]. |
| UAV battery / power and motor / gimbal electronics are direct MXO leads, because UAVEcoChain lists 德鑫新技 in 電池電源 and 其昜先進 in 馬達動力雲台, and the R&S solution mapping lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 as R&S MXO leads [35][41]. |
| High-speed digital SI/PI and PCB/PCBA validation is a broader oscilloscope opportunity, because the R&S digital-test source connects Interface Test and PDN validation to scopes, and the PCB/PCBA flow includes TDR impedance, IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, DK/DF, roughness and process-monitoring contexts, but the source does not tie this directly to a specific A&D account or scope model [51][71][72]. |
| Military / aviation drone EMC and EME is a strong A&D test domain but not yet an oscilloscope-proven opportunity in the vault, because the sources support MIL-STD-461 / MIL-STD-464 / RTCA DO-160 and complex EME emulation needs, but the cited pages do not map RTO, MXO, or scopes to those EMC/EME tests [4][61][62][63]. |
### 產品與 Option 對接表
| 產品線 | 可接軌的需求 | 知識庫確認的 option / 規格 | 為什麼適合 | 證據 | 缺口 / 報價風險 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| R&S RTO | UAV image-processing / camera electronics where 邑錡 is listed with GMSL and LVDS [35][41]. | 知識庫未標示 RTO option code, bandwidth, probe, software, fixture, or test method for this UAV mapping [41]. | The evidence directly maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S RTO and R&S MXO in the UAV solution mapping [41]. | UAVEcoChain lists 邑錡 under 影像處理-相機 with GMSL and LVDS, and the R&S solution mapping lists 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS → R&S RTO, R&S MXO [35][41]. | The mapping cannot be rewritten as a formal configuration guide, sold opportunity, customer adoption, certification, or test result [41]. |
| R&S MXO | UAV image-processing / camera, battery / power, and motor / gimbal nodes where 邑錡, 德鑫新技, and 其昜先進 are mapped to MXO-related leads [35][41]. | 知識庫未標示 MXO option code, bandwidth, probe, software, fixture, or measurement procedure for these UAV mappings [41]. | The evidence directly maps 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS to R&S MXO and also lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 as MXO leads [35][41]. | UAVEcoChain lists 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS → R&S RTO and R&S MXO, and lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 → R&S MXO [35][41]. | The workbook contains many company / role leads but mostly lacks product model, formal specification, customer, supply relationship, shipment, certification, bid, revenue, or market-share evidence [34]. |
| Oscilloscope instrument class | High-speed digital interface test and PDN validation [51]. | 知識庫未標示 oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, jitter mask, PDN impedance target, or formal test standard for this source [51]. | The source explicitly connects Interface Test to scopes, BERTs, AWGs and switch matrices, and connects Power Distribution Network validation to scopes and network analyzers [51]. | The SerDes / SI-PI testing overview lists scopes under Interface Test and PDN validation, and separately lists SI flow items such as IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram and TDR Impedance [49][51]. | This source is a high-speed digital test source and does not by itself prove an Aerospace / Defense customer fit or a specific RTO / MXO configuration [51][60]. |
### 場景切入建議
| 場景 | 推薦組合 | 切入重點 | 未驗證事項 |
|---|---|---|---|
| UAV camera / image-processing boards | R&S RTO or R&S MXO where the account context matches 邑錡 / GMSL / LVDS [35][41]. | Use the directly evidenced UAV mapping first, then support the discussion with the generic high-speed interface-test evidence that scopes are used for Interface Test [41][51]. | The vault does not provide GMSL / LVDS version, data rate, compliance test item, RTO / MXO option, probe, fixture, or pass/fail condition [41][52]. |
| UAV battery / power and motor / gimbal electronics | R&S MXO where the account context matches 德鑫新技 or 其昜先進 [35][41]. | Use the UAVEcoChain mapping because it directly lists 德鑫新技 and 其昜先進 as MXO leads [35][41]. | The vault does not state the electrical measurement item, voltage/current range, power-analysis option, motor-control method, or customer adoption result [34][41]. |
| High-speed PCB/PCBA and SI/PI validation for system houses | Oscilloscope instrument class, with product model to be confirmed outside the current evidence [51][71][72]. | Use the R&S PCB test-solutions flow around TDR impedance, DK/DF extraction, IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, sampling testing and process monitoring [71]. | The source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, license, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method [72]. |
| Military / aviation drone EMC and EME discussions | Do not lead with oscilloscope as a proven solution unless additional evidence is added [4][61][62][63]. | The supported A&D need is EMC / EME standards and complex electromagnetic-environment emulation, including MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464 and RTCA DO-160 contexts [4][61][62]. | The vault does not map RTO, MXO, or oscilloscope measurements to MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, RTCA DO-160, HPM, EMP, lightning, RADHAZ, or EME emulation setups [63]. |
### 限制
The vault does not provide an evidence-based ranking of oscilloscope opportunities in Aerospace / Defense, so no “strongest” ranking is proven [41][51].  
The R&S solution-mapping rows cannot be treated as formal configurations, sold opportunities, customer adoption, certification, or test results [41].  
The high-speed digital and PCB sources do not provide scope model, bandwidth, data rate, option code, fixture, calibration method, or pass/fail criteria [51][72].  
The military / aviation drone EMC and EME sources support the A&D test domain, but they do not provide an oscilloscope product mapping or executable test parameters [63].

來源列出的 main chapter / sub-items 包含：

- margins，6 dB margins。
- intra-system EMC。
- hull generated intermodulation interference / IMI。
- shipboard internal EME。
- multipaction。
- induced levels at antenna ports of antenna-connected receivers。
- external RF EME。
- [[High Power Microwave]] / HPM sources。
- lightning。
- [[Electromagnetic Pulse]] / EMP。
- subsystems and equipment electromagnetic interference / EMI。
- portable electronics devices and carry-on equipment requirements。
- non-developmental items / NDI and commercial items。
- electrostatic environments。
- radiation hazards / RADHAZ：HERP、HERF、HERO。
- life cycle / E3 hardness。
- electrical bonding、power current return path、antenna installations、mechanical interfaces、shock / fault / ignitable vapour protection。
- external grounds。
- TEMPEST。
- system radiated emission、EMCON、platform radiated emission。
- EM spectrum supportability。
